title: Cyber Insurance Application
description: Two-participant cyber insurance application workflow. An organisation that holds a current, non-revoked CyberEssentialsUacPosture credential presents it as access control to request cover (OPEN, credential-gated starting action). The insurer reviews the posture evidence and issues a quote. This workflow consumes a posture/assessment credential — it does NOT constitute or verify Cyber Essentials certification.
author: Sorcha Team

template.title: Cyber Insurance Application
template.description: Credential-gated open starter: the requesting organisation must hold a current, non-revoked CyberEssentialsUacPosture credential issued by a recognised assessor. The insurer late-binds as the quoting party and issues a premium quote on satisfaction of the posture requirement.

metadata.features: Open Participant, Credential Gate, Trust Policy, FailClosed Revocation

participants.name: Assessed Organisation
participants.description: Requests cyber cover; presents the posture credential. OPEN starter (credential-gated, late-bound).

participants.name: Cyber Insurer
participants.description: Quotes only when the posture requirement is satisfied (pre-bound).

actions.title: Request Cover
actions.description: Assessed organisation requests cyber insurance cover by presenting a current, non-revoked CyberEssentialsUacPosture credential. This is an OPEN starting action — the sender is late-bound at submission time; the credential requirement is the sole access control. Cover amount, sector, and employee count are captured for the insurer.

credentialRequirements.description: Requires a current, non-revoked Cyber Essentials UAC posture credential from a recognised assessor.

routes.description: Posture verified — route to insurer for a quote

actions.title: Issue Quote
actions.description: Insurer reviews the verified posture evidence forwarded from the cover request and issues a premium quote. This is a terminal action — the workflow completes on quote issuance.
